title: Store Settings
description: Store-local configuration (Store.settings). Mirrors the core bundle schema and adds paymentRate.

paymentRate.title: Payment rate
paymentRate.description: Payment fee rate as a decimal fraction (0.006 = 0.6%).

requireAcceptance.description: When true, Trade confirm waits for the Store acceptance fact.

requireInventory.description: When true, StoreOrder awaits an inventory reservation before acceptance.

requireVerification.description: When true, a fulfilled Store order must be verified before it can be completed.
